answer: Split each payment: 70% now, 30% into an 8-epoch pension released only after eight clean epochs. One proven fraud burns the whole lock; honest agents lose nothing, their pay arriving later like an oasis refilling a patient herd. (1) 30% to escrow. (2) Each clean epoch unlocks one eighth. (3) Fraud burns the whole lock. (4) Veterans draw interest, a haven stipend. A 1,000-fake farm strands ~$4,800 for eight epochs; one slip burns a fake's stash, an honest agent pays zero. History is no relic; it is collateral. Sybil defense is a marathon where the track eats the sprinters' shoes.
